breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the product of inertia even though the setup explicitly gives a nonzero I_yz and the unsymmetric bending formula depends on it.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly applies the full unsymmetric bending formula using the nonzero product of inertia Iyz = 800000 mm^4 in both the numerator and denominator terms. It does not ignore the product of inertia, and does not use the simplified superposition method (My·z/Iy + Mz·y/Iz) that was incorrectly suggested in the incomplete prompt. The calculation properly computes D = Iy·Iz – Iyz² and uses Iyz in both coefficient A and B, matching the ground truth approach.
